resources.string:
Welcome to the Payment Settings section of our app. Here, you can get a quick snapshot of your current payment setup, including your default payment methods and billing information. This overview provides a consolidated view of all your payment-related settings, ensuring you have everything in one place for easy management.

 What you can do here:

 • Review Payment Methods: View and manage your active payment methods, including credit/debit cards and other payment options.
 • Check Billing Information: Ensure that your billing details are accurate and up-to-date.

 Stay on top of your payment settings to ensure a smooth and seamless experience with our app. For detailed changes or updates, navigate to the Billing and Payment Details sections.
